world.title: He Moved to the US on a Green Card and Wouldn't Do the Same on an H-1B
world.summary: Mohamed Zeeshan, a 32-year-old Indian national residing in Arlington, Virginia, shares his perspective on moving to the US on a green card. He emphasizes that economic upliftment was not his primary motivation for applying for the green card. This narrative reflects his personal journey and experiences as an immigrant, highlighting his thoughts on the immigration process.

world.title: Why US hospitals are outsourcing more work to India-and 2 stocks are riding the trend
world.summary: US hospitals are increasingly outsourcing administrative tasks to Indian companies due to a structural shift in the healthcare system. This trend presents new opportunities for investors, as hundreds of billions are spent on processing healthcare transactions. The move aims to reduce costs and improve efficiency, highlighting the growing role of Indian firms in the US healthcare landscape.

world.title: U.S. slaps 10% tariffs on goods imported from India over issue forced labour
world.summary: The U.S. has imposed 10% tariffs on goods imported from India and 16 other countries due to concerns over forced labor in production. This decision affects a total of 60 countries and was announced by U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer. The tariffs aim to address human rights violations linked to labor practices in various industries.

business.title: Flipkart to launch food delivery over the coming weeks: Group CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy
business.summary: Flipkart, the Walmart-owned e-commerce platform, is set to launch a food delivery service in the coming weeks. This initiative will be in collaboration with the government-backed Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC). The announcement was made by Group CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy, as the company aims to expand its offerings in the competitive food delivery market.

business.title: Off: Dow Jones falls 500 points after crude rally; Alphabet, Tesla drag Nasdaq
business.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 500 points, with a low of over 650 points during the day. The S&P 500 declined by 1.2%, and the Nasdaq Composite fell 2.1%. Major contributors to the Nasdaq's decline included Tesla, which fell 14.5% to its lowest since March 2025, and Alphabet, which decreased by 7%.

technology.title: Chaos Ransomware Turns Your Chrome and Edge Web Browser Into an Invisible Malware Command Channel
technology.summary: Chaos ransomware has developed a method to conceal its activities within Chrome and Edge browsers using the msaRAT remote-access tool. This allows attackers to stealthily receive commands and exfiltrate data, turning these commonly used browsers into hidden channels for malicious operations. The technique enhances the ransomware's ability to operate undetected during web browsing sessions, posing significant security risks.

technology.title: T-Mobile and AT&T offer the Galaxy Z Fold8 for free, Z Fold8 Ultra for $200
technology.summary: T-Mobile and AT&T are offering the Galaxy Z Fold8 for free and the Z Fold8 Ultra for $200. Additionally, there are promotions for the Galaxy Z Flip8 and the new Galaxy Watch9 and Watch Ultra2. The Galaxy Z Flip8 and Z Fold8 Ultra are priced $100 higher than previous models, with Samsung providing pre-order discounts.

technology.title: MacBook Neo 2 Reportedly Getting 12GB RAM and New Colors
technology.summary: The MacBook Neo 2 is expected to feature 12GB of RAM and an A19 Pro chip, with a release targeted for the first half of 2027. New color options are also anticipated, although no pricing information has been confirmed. The upgrade aims to address previous concerns regarding RAM capacity in comparison to other laptops on the market.

sports.title: Captaincy weighed him down, freedom set him free: The remarkable second act of Joe Root
sports.summary: Joe Root concluded the ODI series against India unbeaten, amassing 249 runs across three innings, leading England to a 2-1 series victory. At 36 years old, Root's performance highlights his resurgence after stepping down from captaincy, allowing him to play with greater freedom. His achievements contrast with many peers who have retired, showcasing his enduring talent in cricket.

sports.title: GAW vs SFU Today Match Prediction and Betting Tips, Odds and Live Score
sports.summary: The Guyana Amazon Warriors (GAW) will play against the San Francisco Unicorns (SFU) in the second match of the Global Super League 2026. The match is scheduled for July 24, 2026, at 04:30 IST, taking place at Providence Stadium in Guyana. GAW enters the match as the defending champions, aiming to secure a victory against SFU.

sports.title: Shakira, BTS Outfits, Game Ball
sports.summary: Christie's is hosting a charity auction, "One Goal," to benefit the FIFA Global Citizen Education Fund. The auction features USA World Cup merchandise and items worn by celebrities including Lionel Messi, Shakira, BTS, and Justin Bieber. This event comes as fans petition FIFA to replay the 2026 World Cup final match, offering a chance to own memorabilia.

health.title: Health Experts Issue Summer Travel Food Safety Alert as Soaring Heat and Weak Cold Chains Increase Foodborne Illness Risks: New Travel Alert
health.summary: Health experts have issued a summer travel food safety alert due to heightened risks of foodborne illnesses from extreme heat, flight delays, and compromised hotel buffets. Record-breaking temperatures and transportation disruptions are contributing factors. Travelers are advised to take precautions when consuming food during trips to mitigate potential health risks associated with inadequate food storage and handling.

health.title: Beyond the Fog
health.summary: Experts indicate that non-cognitive symptoms such as changes in mood, sleep, smell, and movement may appear years or even decades before dementia is diagnosed. While impaired memory and thinking are commonly recognized symptoms, these early indicators can provide critical insights into an individual's cognitive health. Awareness of these signs may aid in earlier detection and intervention strategies for dementia.

health.title: Study Maps Motor Abnormalities Across Mental Health Spectrums
health.summary: A recent study employed the Hierarchical Taxonomy of Psychopathology (HiToP) to investigate motor symptoms linked to various mental health spectrums and psychosis risk. Analyzing data from nearly 3,500 participants without formal diagnoses, researchers assessed self-reported motor functions and psychological dimensions, revealing significant correlations that could enhance understanding of the relationship between motor abnormalities and mental health conditions.

science.title: Scientists Watch Chemistry Unfold Atom by Atom
science.summary: Scientists have developed a new method to observe electronic and vibrational dynamics in real time, allowing them to track molecular changes within trillionths of a second after light absorption. This technique reveals how molecules bend, shift electrons, and convert electronic energy into vibrations, providing insights into fundamental chemical processes and potentially advancing fields such as materials science and photochemistry.

science.title: Integrated experimental and computational characterization of bioactive metabolites from Streptomyces paradoxus GH53 with antimicrobial, antioxidant, and antitumor activities
science.summary: Streptomyces paradoxus GH53 was identified and characterized for its bioactive metabolites with antimicrobial, antioxidant, and antitumor activities. Fermentation conditions were optimized, and the crude extract analyzed via GC-MS, FT-IR, and UV-Vis spectroscopy. The extract showed significant cytotoxicity against HePG-2 and MCF-7 cell lines. Molecular docking indicated favorable interactions with relevant protein targets, though some metabolites showed potential toxicity concerns.

science.title: Sperm whales blow bubbles to achieve restful, vertical sleep
science.summary: Research from the University of St Andrews and Université de Neuchâtel reveals how sperm whales can sleep vertically just below the ocean surface. This unique sleeping position is facilitated by the whales blowing bubbles, which helps them maintain stability while resting. Sperm whales are the only known whale species to adopt this vertical sleeping posture.
